svg.title: Suppose another complete four-record law P ′ is generated through a quantum causal cut of dimension at most three. All history-correlated systems used again in the future belong to that cut; independent fresh ports and an untouched retained archive obey the same convention as the accounting chapter. The competing law may have a different update rule, lack stationarity, or lie outside the trine family. Extra null/loss outcomes can remain in its complete alphabet, with zero target probability. Put δ = TV(P ′, Pλ,4) < 1/9. Restrict its joint table H′ to the target trit pairs and let h′ cd = P ab H′ ab,cd ≥1/9 −δ. The column-normalized matrix C′ ab,cd = H′ ab,cd/h′ cd still has PSD rank at most three. Define
